title: JOVRA Studio Quote (jovra.quote/1)
description: A server-computed preflight quote in Studio Credits: estimate, cap, retention and expiry, from actual source bytes, angles, profile and output. capCredits = max(class minimum, ceil(estimatedMaxCostMicroUsd / creditCostBudgetMicroUsd)) per spec/studio/contracts/credit-classes.v1.json (a proposal, not a price). An illustrative quote (the screen-37 $4-$8 estimate and $12 cap) is Sample UX only and can never be accepted. Timestamps are ordered by parsing, never as text. No live charging exists (ADR-0013).

outputSpecSha256.description: Binds the quote (and the consent recorded in it) to one output: canonical SHA-256 of (projectId, planRevision, output) of the stored plan version, computed by the server (core.output_spec_sha256), never taken from the client. A reservation funded by this quote must carry the same value, and an accepted quote funds at most one reservation.

plannerChoice.description: Who plans the story for this quote (spec D-5, ADR-0016). 'heuristic': the rules planner, no model call, plannerTokensEstimate 0, consent.modelProvider false. 'model': the player switched on 'Plan the story in the cloud' (ST37); an accepted model quote needs consent.modelProvider true. A film funded by this quote binds the same planner kind.

retentionDays.description: Days the work-bucket media (staged originals, proxies, frames, PTS tables, contact sheets, previews) is kept (spec D-3, SD23): 7 by default, 1 or 30 by the player's choice at preflight; equals lineItems.storageDays and consent.retentionDays.

modelProvider.description: The explicit consent that sampled frames, structured events and the ticked note classes go to the planning model provider (D-5, SD19). Required true for plannerChoice 'model'; false for 'heuristic'.

textClasses.description: Note text classes that may reach the model (security-model section 13.14). Empty unless modelProvider is true.

retentionDays.description: The retention the player confirmed; equals the quote's retentionDays.

consentTextVersion.description: Version of the consent copy shown (ST37), e.g. studio-cloud-consent@1.0.0.
